title: WhalesIslandReef D18 logic asset record
description: Canonical machine-verifiable logical record for a candidate external asset (D18-L02). It records provenance, license, rights, hash, state, content mapping and evidence as static data only; it never grants approval, imports assets or edits the Content Registry. Records claiming RuntimeApproved or ReleaseApproved must carry the corresponding evidence fields; the logic phase itself never produces such grants. Field semantics follow the D18_LOGIC_GOVERNANCE_BASELINE section 6.1 frozen dictionary.

repo_relative_path.description: Repository-relative path only. Absolute paths, drive letters (C:), UNC names (\\server), backslashes, leading slashes, whitespace and '..' traversal segments are forbidden.

canonical_asset_id.description: Stable business key in lower snake_case (asset_<...>). Never a disk path, an absolute path or a display name.

category.description: Logical category. Starter vocabulary is grounded in the real intake catalog domains and the local-development-ready categories (2026-08-16 baseline snapshot); the authoritative taxonomy dictionary is frozen by L11-L14 and cross-checked by L45.

taxonomy_category.description: Optional domain fine-grained category (two-layer contract, D18-L51). When present, its value must exist in tools/schemas/d18_taxonomy_category_map.json and the mapped parent_category must equal the record's category; an unknown taxonomy_category or a parent mismatch is invalid (P0). Records without taxonomy_category remain legal. It never replaces category, never widens the 11-value enum and never implies any runtime or release right.

source_url.description: Official source URL. Recorded statically; never fetched over the network.

license.description: Normalized license object (L04 normalizes; unknown/conflicting/NC must be blocked or pending, never guessed as CC0).

rights.description: Four distribution rights, each explicitly recorded (L07 validates them against the license).

download_date.description: Actual download date; null when not downloaded. Never invent a date.

original_filename.description: Original package/file name. Renaming must not create a new pack identity.

sha256.description: Real 64-hex digest of the file/archive; null (pending) when the original file is missing. Never guessed.

state.description: One of the seven frozen states (baseline section 2). Unknown or historical approval states (e.g. Approved, LocalDevelopmentReady) are rejected. Transition order is validated by L35; this schema only enforces the evidence each state requires.

content_ids.description: Content mapping keys in lower snake_case (grounded in the 1,865 real intake entries). Referenced keys must exist; L15 checks existence and forbids game data depending on candidate files.

evidence_paths.description: Repo-relative evidence file paths; no absolute-path leaks.

runtime_deferred.description: Per-record runtime risks, honestly registered; deferral never replaces a passing gate.

human_reviewer.description: Required only when state is ReleaseApproved.

human_review_date.description: Required only when state is ReleaseApproved.

release_evidence_path.description: Required only when state is ReleaseApproved.

runtime_consumers.description: Controlled consumers of an approved record; required only when state is RuntimeApproved.
